theory: An unused hypothesis does not invalidate an implication when the next case is independently proved; distinguish the booklet's required setout from logical validity. Manipulating a target equation through justified reversible equivalences can prove it, so remove the blanket prohibition and explain that an unproved assumption followed only by one-way implications is insufficient. Qualify the claim about angles and real variables: induction can prove statements involving them when an integer index controls the induction, as the booklet's final trigonometric sum demonstrates.
